title: Smartwall WPT Simulation: Coupled-Mode Near-Field Wireless Power Transfer with Fresnel RIS and Non-Linear Schottky Rectenna Modeling
description: Open-science analytical, numerical, and Monte Carlo simulation suite validating near-field Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) using Coupled-Mode Theory (CMT), Fresnel Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS), phase-conjugate beamforming, and non-linear Schottky rectenna efficiency modeling.
